overview.about: The ShopRite LPGA Classic is one of the tour's most enduring events, played on the Bay Course at Seaview on the New Jersey shore. The short, breezy, historic layout near Atlantic City has a charm all its own.
overview.nextEvent: The next ShopRite LPGA Classic is played at the Seaview Bay Course in Galloway, New Jersey. Coastal wind is the main defence of the classic, walkable seaside layout.
